from agentscope.message import Msg, ToolResultBlock, ImageBlock, TextBlock

msg = Msg\('system', [
    ToolResultBlock\(type='tool_result', id='x', name='send_file_to_user', output=[
        ImageBlock\(type='image', source={'type': 'url', 'url': 'file:///test.png'}\),
        TextBlock\(type='text', text='Image file sent'\),
    ]\)
], 'system'\)

print\('content type:', type\(msg.content\)\)
print\('content:', msg.content\)
print\('get_content_blocks:', msg.get_content_blocks\(\)\)
for b in msg.get_content_blocks\(\):
    print\('  block type:', b.get\('type'\)\)
    if b.get\('type'\) == 'tool_result':
        print\('    output:', b.get\('output'\)\)
        for ob in b.get\('output', []\):
            print\('      ob type:', ob.get\('type'\)\)
")
